 Preliminary magnitude 6.9 earthquake hits off the coast of Vanuatu 
 A preliminary magnitude 6.9 earthquake has hit off the coast of Vanuatu Saturday, according to the U.S. Geological Survey, prompting a tsunami warning for the area that was later rescinded 
 1:26 By The Associated Press October 24, 2026, 12:32 AM Share A preliminary magnitude 6.9 earthquake on Saturday hit off the coast of Vanuatu , according to the U.S. Geological Survey, prompting a tsunami warning for the area that was later rescinded.
 The quake in the South Pacific struck at around 1:30 p.m. and was centered 197 kilometers (122 miles) west-northwest of Port Olry, at a depth of 10 km (6 miles). Several aftershocks were later recorded in the area, including a preliminary magnitude 6.3 quake, according to the USGS.
